ravi (Finance): FYI: small hosted billing update -> launching Sep 15, 2026. Two quick changes: (1) invoices will show per-model + region line items (better chargeback), (2) default free trial credit for new signups reduced to 20k tokens. Full doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/billing/sep-2026-invoice-update :loud_sound:
maya (Growth): Will promo credits for events be impacted?
ravi (Finance): No, promo/partner credits unaffected. This only changes the default trial for self-serve accounts.
jun (Eng): Any runtime impact or new headers?
ravi (Finance): No runtime change. We added an API endpoint to fetch invoice previews and a small SDK patch for parsing itemized invoices. No rate-limit changes.
kate (Customer Success): Grandfathering? customers who signed up recently?
ravi (Finance): Accounts created before Sep 15 are grandfathered for 30 days at the old trial amount. CS will get an export of impacted accounts and email templates.
billing-bot: SAMPLE: https://billing.redwood.internal/samples/sep2026-itemized.pdf :page_facing_up:
ravi (Finance): Rollout plan: staged flag Sep 1, GA Sep 15. Questions -> #billing-questions or finance@redwood.com. Exec signoff: Ravinder (CFO). :white_check_mark:
